title: The Pratfall Effect: Why Mistakes Make You Likable

visual.description: A close-up of a man in a sharp business suit adjusting his collar and tie in a mirror, looking intensely serious.

vo.en: You might think a flawless image is impressive, but it actually creates a cold wall between you and others.
vo.fr: On croit que l'image idéale impressionne, mais elle crée surtout une barrière froide avec ton entourage.

visual.description: A wide angle shot of a cold, modern glass skyscraper reflecting the sky, looking imposing and unreachable.

vo.en: Psychology shows that when a highly competent person makes a clumsy mistake, their likability actually skyrockets.
vo.fr: La psychologie prouve que si une personne brillante fait une maladresse, elle devient immédiatement plus attachante.

visual.description: Slow motion footage of hot coffee splashing out of a mug onto a wooden desk surface next to a notebook.

vo.en: It’s the Pratfall Effect. Spilling coffee or tripping slightly makes an expert seem approachable rather than intimidating.
vo.fr: C'est l'Effet de Chute. Renverser son café rend un expert humain et accessible au lieu d'être intimidant.

visual.description: A man's hands fumbling with a set of keys while trying to open a heavy wooden door.

vo.en: Total perfection is boring and unrelatable. Vulnerability is the secret bridge that builds instant social trust and connection.
vo.fr: La perfection est ennuyeuse. C'est ta vulnérabilité qui crée ce lien invisible et cette confiance partagée avec les autres.

visual.description: A man sitting outside laughing genuinely, showing authentic emotion with natural facial movements.

vo.en: So embrace your small blunders—they make you real. Follow to spot your mental blindspots. Because really, you should...
vo.fr: Accepte tes petites erreurs, elles sont ta force. Abonne-toi pour tes check-ups mentaux. Car au fond, tu devrais...

visual.description: A close-up of a person's thumb scrolling rapidly through a social media feed on a glowing smartphone screen.
